description: Reader vector for the keystroke rows' effect_status. A reply carrying an effect_status value the reader does not know must be read as effect_indeterminate (the keys may have landed), never as not-run, so a status added in a later revision can never make an older caller retry keystrokes that landed. Nothing in this repository parses effect_status back out of a reply; the model reading computer_use replies is the reader, so this vector pins the rule the vocabulary states for it.
